doc.title: Byron Stripling interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 25, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Closing
summary: Rowe thanks Stripling and hopes for a second interview.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I have a feeling we’re going to have to do Part Two down the road, because we didn’t get to a lot of stuff I wanted to talk to you about but I know you’re on your way. It’s been a pleasure to have you here at the college, and I hope we can do it again. So thanks for your time.
